To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the alien chromosome can be transferred from the Ae. tauschiiiinto triticale background, (2) the alien chromosome 2D undergoes rearrangements in triticale background and (3) the alien chromosome carrying the Rht8 and Pm genes can be used in triticale breeding.
we developed triticale monsomic addition lines with powdery mildews resistant chromosome 2D.
the alien chromatin of Ae. taushii can be used in triticale breeding program for the development of semi-dwarf plants with resistance to Blumeriagraminis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of molecular cytogenetics and SSR markers for the identification of monosomic addition line with chromosome 2A, 2B and 2D from Ae. tauschiii.
the development and analysis of triticale MAALs with the chromosome 2DS of Ae. taushii, which is an important source of resistance to powdery mildews.
the use of monosomic addition of Ae. taushii chromosome 2D in the triticales breeding programs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the monosomic alien addition line with 2D chromosome of Ae. taushii in triticale background is an effective tool for transferring the powdery resistance and for mapping of the genes determining agronomical important traits.
monosomic addition line 2D is a valuable tool in triticale improvement.
the chromosome 2 of Ae. taushii × S. cereale hybrid can be used as a genetic resource in triticale breeding.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully developed triticale lines with chromosome 1D and 2D from Ae. tauschiii.
the alien chromosome 2D is a good candidate for triticale improvement.
the alien chromosome can be used as a tool for the improvement of agronomic traits of hexaploid triticales.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the monosomic alien addition method is an effective tool to transfer genes from wild relatives and to study the effect of alien genes on the host genome.

monosomic addition of chromosome 2A of Ae. tauschiito triticale can result in a high level of variability of the genome and its expression, what is related, among others, to the powdery-mildew resistance.
monosomic addition line carrying chromosome 2DS of Ae. tauschiicould be a valuable genetic stock for further studies of powdery midew resistance in triticale.
